rfm-analysis.pseudocode:
def quintile(values, higher_better=True):
    n = len(values)
    order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: values[i])
    score = [0] * n
    for rank, i in enumerate(order):  # 하위 20% → 1점
        q = rank * 5 // n + 1
        score[i] = q if higher_better else 6 - q
    return score

def rfm(customers, today):
    rec = [(today - c.last_buy).days for c in customers]
    r = quintile(rec, higher_better=False)  # 최근일수록 높음
    f = quintile([c.count for c in customers])
    m = quintile([c.amount for c in customers])
    return {c.id: (r[i], f[i], m[i])
            for i, c in enumerate(customers)}
